text:
Latency numbers (approx.)

L1 cache ref ................... 0.5 ns
Main memory ref .............. 100 ns
SSD random read ............. ~100 us
Read 1 MB from memory ...... ~250 us
Same-DC round trip .......... 0.5 ms
Read 1 MB from SSD .......... ~1 ms
Disk seek ...................... 10 ms
Cross-continent round trip .. ~150 ms
